CustomField.description: Pipeline Health gate for the two overage milestones (Overage Driver, Overage Confirmed). On Midterm New Product they apply only when the opportunity subtype is Additional Product + Increase Usage. Every other record type, including Midterm Other: always true. Keyed on Record Type ID so flow entry conditions can reference it.
CustomField.formula: IF(LEFT(RecordTypeId, 15) = "012PU00000MDu2v", Opportunity_Sub__c = "Additional Product + Increase Usage", TRUE)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: True when the overage milestones count for this deal. Only Midterm New Product deals with subtype Additional Product + Increase Usage turn this on for that type.
CustomField.label: PH overage milestones apply
